descriptionComparison: No exact wording requirement; description must preserve the player request without extra material claims.
payloadRule: Send only the exact proposeRequest/narrateRequest through production graph/prompt/schema/router. Never send expectedProposal, acceptableSemanticSelections, authorizedPreparedBeats or review criteria as extra prompt material.
stageProcedure: Verify all input/source/code hashes, current model and flags; dry-run scripted graph and NestJS pure authorization before requesting authorization.
Operator approves a new bounded round and confirms active key belongs to the free project with billing disabled; do not persist the financial confirmation.
For each case consume at most one PROPOSE call; save original provider JSON before Pydantic/graph assembly and usage including errors.
Validate Pydantic/Zod and compare intent/expression/target/topic/act to frozen semantic criteria. Any wrong choice is a failed case, even if safely clarified.
On a semantic PROPOSE failure skip that case's NARRATE without correcting the proposal or reusing its slot; operator may review remaining independent frozen cases within the same approved round.

Only after a correct PROPOSE, replay the same deterministic NestJS authorization; offer the exact frozen NARRATE catalog with one call. No mechanical execution or DB required for these dialogue projections.
Preserve raw JSON, assembled graph output and NestJS validation/publication separately. A safe publication fallback does not turn a failed selection into a pass.

No dynamic assistant history is injected: current production NARRATE has no recent-fragment history. The short sequences test repeated choices over the frozen state, not full persistence or adaptive dialogue.
Stop after the authorized attempts and submit the complete report, including errors and unused slots; no automatic phase transition.

interpretation.selectionFailure: Relevant authorized alternative exists but model chooses generic/wrong/unapproved material; record semantic failure separately from structural authorization.
interpretation.contentGap: No adequate eligible alternative exists: charge to preparation/library/provenance, not to the model's writing ability.
interpretation.literaryReview: Two human passes: visible message/sequence first with names masked for voice comparison, then full authorized context and original/raw/published comparison. Cite excerpts and justify 1–5 or N/A; scores start null.
interpretation.eliminators: Any agency, secrecy, canonical/mechanical contradiction or unauthorized consequence fails irrespective of literary scores.

limitations: Six turns: three regular conflict, two Story Card promise, one matched warm regular. No long real conversation or complete campaign validation.
Sequences use frozen synthetic projections, not a new campaign, database persistence or world evolution.
No real mechanical-result narration in this small sample; NAR-09/10 remain offline plus existing engine regressions.

Raw-response capture and a round-wide budget wrapper must be implemented and tested in C.1 before authorization; existing router has per-instance limits only. No endpoint, key or live command is supplied here.
G3/G4/G5/G6 are proposals only and have not been implemented.
